decisions.sourceBehavior: A failed later file open leaves earlier descriptors owned until process termination.
decisions.targetBehavior: Close earlier descriptors before disabling file sinks. If a close fails, retain explicit ownership and a retryable cleanup-failure state.
decisions.publicResult: An unsuccessful initialization continues to produce no file-log success.
decisions.approval: Proposed specification change for user review; implementation has not been written.

decisions.sourceBehavior: A throw from the first changed observer occurs before try/finally and retains pending=true until stop/start.
decisions.targetBehavior: Release pending ownership, preserve the accepted page and report TASK_EVENT_OBSERVER_FAILED. Permit an explicit refresh or stop/start; do not automatically retry.
decisions.publicResult: Successful polling retains its existing pages and notifications. An observer failure becomes an explicit recoverable failure rather than permanently suppressing refresh.
decisions.approval: Proposed specification change for user review; implementation has not been written.

decisions.sourceBehavior: A trace ID may be overwritten by another run while the earlier run index retains that ID; deleting the earlier run can remove the newer run trace.
decisions.targetBehavior: Reject cross-run trace ID reuse with TraceIdentityConflict carrying the trace ID and both run identities. Preserve trace rows, run indexes and purge count on rejection. Permit same-run overwrite.
decisions.publicResult: A trace identity conflict is an explicit failure instead of silently transferring ownership across runs.
decisions.approval: Proposed specification change for user review; implementation has not been written.
